title: iQOO Z11's India launch teased by the company CEO
description: iQOO launched the Z11 Lite last month, and a few days ago, a media report claimed that the brand was planning to launch the Z11 in India. That report has turned out to be correct, as iQOO India's CEO Nipun Marya has teased the launch of the Z11. In a post on X, Marya said, "DO NOT READ THE FIRST LETTER OF EVERY LINE," and wrote seven lines after that, whose first letters were Z, E, L, E, V, E, and N. Well, that's Z11. DO NOT READ THE FIRST LETTER OF EVERY LINE. Zero spoilers from me. Everything is nearly ready. Launch mode is officially on. Eleven may be relevant. Very relevant. Excited...

title: Deals: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra discounted, Galaxy Z Fold8 series up for pre-order
description: Samsung will begin shipping its recently unveiled Galaxy Z Fold8, Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip8 on August 7. The same applies for the Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra2. And those who pre-order the new devices are eligible to receive Amazon gift cards worth up to $350. Meanwhile, there are also discounts on the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and a few other Galaxy phones. Those looking to buy an Apple smartwatch, the Watch Series 11 has been discounted. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 introduces a new form factor with a 4:3 aspect ratio for the inner display and a wider cover screen....

title: Motorola Razr 70 Swarovski Edition's design revealed through leaked renders
description: Last August, Motorola launched a Swarovski Edition of the Razr 60, called the Razr 2025 in North America. We now learn the brand will give the Swarovski treatment to this year's Razr 70/Razr 2026 as well, as renders of the Motorola Razr 70 Swarovski Edition have surfaced online. Last year's Razr 60 Swarovski Edition came in Pantone Ice Melt color, but this year's Swarovski Edition Razr will come in a black shade. You can see that the rear panel of the Motorola Razr 70 Swarovski Edition is textured and arranged in a quilted pattern. It features small crystal-like elements arranged in...

title: CMF Clip Pro Bluetooth earphones are coming next week
description: Nothing's CMF teased new wireless earphones a couple of days ago, which we now know are the CMF Clip Pro OWS earphones. CMF dropped a short video clip on X, announcing the August 4 launch of the Clip Pro and giving us a glimpse of the earphones. Clip Pro. 4 August. pic.twitter.com/ig2yi2xfJi— CMF by Nothing (@cmfbynothing) July 31, 2026 CMF didn't divulge anything else about the Clip Pro, but since the unveiling is just three days away, there's not much left to wait to know all about the brand's first OWS earphones.

description: Investment analyst Jeff Pu has shared a new research note with GF Securities today, and it's all about the upcoming iPhone Air 2. The device is expected to be launched in the first quarter of 2027, so before the end of March. According to Pu, the iPhone Air 2 will be powered by the A20 Pro chip, just like the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The chip will be made using TSMC's 2nm process. iPhone Air The iPhone Air 2 will also have a smaller dynamic island than the original iPhone Air, and will get a 48MP ultrawide camera to complement its main shooter. title: Motorola Watch Ultra renders leak
description: It seems like Motorola is now getting ready to enter the Ultra smartwatch fray, competing directly with the likes of Apple and Samsung. Today some renders showing what's purported to be the upcoming Motorola Watch Ultra have leaked. As you can see, it has a circular screen, a large rotating crown at 10 o’clock with the Motorola logo on it, and a button at four o’clock. The printed text on the watch's rear confirms its 50m water resistance, IP68 dust and water resistance, as well as its 46mm stainless steel case, and the presence of GPS and LTE on board. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE's camera specs surface
description: A Samsung executive recently confirmed the existence of the Galaxy S26 FE, with a company representative hinting the phone will launch this year. While we await more details about the Galaxy S26 FE's launch from Samsung, its camera specs have surfaced online, revealing the camera system won't be entirely different from the Galaxy S25 FE's. This information comes from the folks at Android Authority, which they say is based on evidence they have "reviewed from a trusted source." According to their source, the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, codenamed "r14," will use a 50MP Samsung ISOCELL S5KGN3...

title: WhatsApp is planning a new folder for messages from large businesses
description: WhatsApp is apparently aware of the fact that a lot of its users are facing a problem with clutter in their main chat list, especially due to having a lot of separate threads with messages from large businesses like banks or airlines. So, according to a new report, WhatsApp is now testing what it thinks is a solution to this problem. Messages from large businesses will automatically be moved into a new "Offers & Updates" folder after a set number of hours have passed since they were received. WhatsApp is testing different durations for this feature, up to 24 hours. If you don't like...

title: Samsung may be preparing a surprise device for next year
description: A few days ago, a report from Korea suggested that Samsung was going to launch eight flagship devices next year, including four foldables - the Flip9, Fold9, Fold9 Ultra, the TriFold 2. Today, a different source has unveiled the codenames for Samsung's foldable lineup for 2027, and there are five of them: B9, H9, Q9A, Q9B, and Z9. The Flip8's codename was B8, making B9 rather obviously the Flip9 - so it hasn't been canceled like a previous rumor suggested. Similarly, the Fold8's codename was H8, so H9 is the Fold9. That much is simple. The Q9A and Q9B seem like they would be two...

title: Microsoft will release a Copilot super app this year
description: Microsoft is getting ready to create a single Copilot AI "super app" that will incorporate chat, coding, Cowork, and its new autonomous Autopilots. The app will be available for both consumers and businesses later this year. This information comes from Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, who revealed the strategy during the company's latest earnings call. Microsoft is only the latest company to join the race to create AI "super apps" which support chat, coding, and agents. OpenAI has ChatGPT Work, while Claude has Cowork inside the chatbot. title: Google Pixel 11 leaks in some fresh new renders too
description: Yesterday the legendary leaker Evan Blass aka @evleaks shared some new marketing renders of the upcoming Pixel 11 Pro Fold, and today he's back with the 'vanilla' Pixel 11. Google Pixel 11 leaked marketing renders Like the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, the Pixel 11 will come with Gemini Intelligence. The design is similar to the Pixel 10, but the camera island's full width is now covered by glass. title: Apple won't be able to meet demand in Q3
description: During his last call with investors before stepping down, Apple CEO Tim Cook laid out that the upcoming September quarter (Q3) will have huge customer demand that the supply chain won't be able to meet. Cook stressed that it isn't a case of RAM constraints or lack of parts, but that, put simply, customer demand for iPhones, iPads, and Macs is too great, and supply partners can't keep up. He said, "this isn't a partner or supplier issue. The issue is an incredibly strong demand." title: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy SmartTag3 will have a new shape
description: Samsung launched the original Galaxy SmartTag in 2021, and the SmartTag2 in 2023. Now it seems like it's almost ready to release the SmartTag3, but this will come with a twist. According to the leaked illustrations you can see below, the next Galaxy SmartTag will have a new, squircle-like shape. That said, it doesn't seem to have a built-in lanyard hole, so you may need to buy separate cases to attach it to your keys. There's apparently a button in the center, similar to the one on the original SmartTag. Pressing it could help you find your connected Galaxy phone, and...

title: Qualcomm chipsets are officially getting a price hike
description: Following speculation about an imminent price hike on its chipsets, Qualcomm has officially confirmed that it will indeed raise its Snapdragon chip prices across the board. As confirmed by CEO Cristiano Amon during an interview with CNBC, Snapdragon chips will be more expensive from September 1. Amon cited the increase in input costs across the entire chipset production process as the main reason for the imminent price hikes. A separate press release from Qualcomm outlined that the company can no longer absorb the increased production costs without raising its product...

Xiaomi Pad 8S Pro is on the way with Xiaomi's next self-developed chipset at the helm
description: The Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro made its debut in September of last year, and now the company is apparently working on a new model called the Xiaomi Pad 8S Pro. The leaked image below shows part of the upcoming device’s About screen, which reveals all of its main specs. The tablet is powered by Xiaomi's own Xring O3 SoC, paired with 16GB of RAM. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro to launch next week, key features and pricing revealed
description: Yesterday, an online retailer in India teased the arrival of the Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro. Now, Samsung has revealed the handset's launch date and confirmed some of its key specifications. The Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro will launch in India on August 3 and will be available for purchase through Flipkart and Samsung's official online store. According to its official product page on Samsung India's website, the Galaxy F70 Pro will be powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. title: Motorola Moto Pad 70 Groove arrives with a 12.1" display, a 9-unit JBL Pro Speaker System, and a 10,200 mAh battery
description: Motorola introduced the Moto Pad 70 Pro last month, and today, it unveiled the Moto Pad 70 Groove, advertised as the "ultimate entertainment tablet designed for consumers who demand immersive entertainment, cinematic sound, premium design, and limitless versatility." Motorola tries to deliver all of that with a 12.1" 120Hz LCD of 2,560x1,600-pixel resolution having an 800 nits peak brightness, 98% DCI-P3 color gamut, and support for Dolby Vision and HDR10. title: Strong iPhone demand and services revenue propelled Apple’s Q3 earnings
description: It was another record-breaking quarter for Apple as strong iPhone demand and revenue from its services were enough to overcome the global memory chip supply constraints that are plaguing the industry. Revenues stood at $109.4 billion - up 16% compared to last year. Net profits came in at $29.8 billion, which is a 27% lift from Q3,2025. Apple had yet another strong quarter of iPhone demand with revenues reaching $54.2 billion for the three-month period ending on June 27, 2026. title: OnePlus N6x debuts with a Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset, a 7,000mAh battery
description: After several teasers, OnePlus has officially launched the N6x in India. The new handset is a more affordable version of the OnePlus N6, which debuted late last month. The OnePlus N6x features a 6.8-inch LCD display with an HD+ resolution and a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. Under the hood, the phone is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset, paired with 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of internal storage.
